description: SeatGeek Platform API provides event, venue, performer, taxonomy, and recommendation data. Event records may include aggregate listing statistics such as listing count and average, lowest, and highest prices, but the public v2 API does not expose individual ticket listings; users must follow SeatGeek URLs to view tickets.
resolution_notes: Description: corrected. SeatGeek's current official v2 documentation defines event-level aggregate listing statistics and explicitly states that individual ticket listings are not exposed. SeatGeek's 2026 Platform page still links to these API docs. Evidence: https://seatgeek.github.io/ and https://seatgeek.com/build
